topic: OCI Runtime Specification as the governing standard for container isolation
title: Open Container Initiative - Open Container Initiative
snippet: The OCI Runtime Spec defines the behavior and the configuration interface of low-level container runtimes such as runc. The spec is also implemented by crun, youki, gVisor, Kata Containers, and others.
claim: OCI Runtime Spec is the standard interface for container isolation implementations

topic: OCI Runtime Specification v1.3 release with FreeBSD support
title: OCI Runtime Spec v1.3 - Open Container Initiative
snippet: The OCI Runtime Spec v1.3.0 was released on November 4, 2025, containing 24 pull requests merged since the 1.2.1 release.
claim: OCI Runtime Spec v1.3 released November 2025 with expanded platform support

topic: Firecracker microVM OCI Runtime compliance and implementation
title: firecracker-containerd: enables containerd to manage containers as Firecracker microVMs
snippet: The runtime strives for OCI runtime compliance within the bounds of Firecracker's feature set. To maintain compatibility with the container ecosystem, where possible, the project uses container standards such as the OCI image format.
claim: Firecracker integrates as an OCI-compliant runtime through firecracker-containerd

topic: Container isolation tradeoffs: gVisor syscall interception vs hardware VM isolation
query: gVisor Kata Containers Cloud Hypervisor sandbox isolation
title: Kata Containers vs Firecracker vs gVisor: Which container isolation tool should you use?
snippet: gVisor improves container security by intercepting syscalls in userspace, but it does not provide hardware-level isolation. Kata Containers run workloads inside lightweight virtual machines, integrating natively with Kubernetes. Cloud Hypervisor was chosen for its strong runtime performance, broad workload compatibility, and stability in production.
claim: Multiple OCI-compliant isolation strategies exist with different security/performance tradeoffs

topic: Kata Containers with Cloud Hypervisor as modern MicroVM approach in 2026
query: gVisor Kata Containers Cloud Hypervisor sandbox isolation
title: How to sandbox AI agents in 2026: MicroVMs, gVisor & isolation strategies
snippet: Kata Containers is an open-source container runtime that runs workloads inside lightweight virtual machines, integrating natively with Kubernetes via CRI. Kata is maintained under the OpenInfra Foundation and supports Cloud Hypervisor (default), Firecracker, and QEMU as VMM backends.
claim: Kata Containers supports multiple hypervisor backends for pluggable isolation implementation

topic: runc as most common OCI runtime using Linux kernel namespaces and cgroups
title: What Is a Standard Container: Diving Into the OCI Runtime Spec
snippet: runc is the most common container execution tool that interacts directly with the Linux kernel to implement container isolation and resource management using cgroups and namespaces.
claim: runc reference implementation uses kernel namespaces and cgroups for isolation
